claim_scores.rationale: Creates `dspy.ReAct("question -> answer", tools=[get_weather])`, which is the minimal one-tool agent.
Reads `agent.react.signature.instructions` into `instructions` and prints it for inspection.
Asserts both `get_weather` and `Get the weather for a city.` appear in `instructions`.
Asserts `finish` appears in the generated instructions.
Asserts the JSON-format reminder string for `next_tool_args` appears in `instructions`.
Formats the signature as a system message and asserts `next_tool_name` is present.
